degree_composition.boundary_homotopy: Uniform lateral-boundary nonvanishing preserves the mu=0 boundary winding zero throughout 0<=mu<=1.
degree_composition.imported_local_index: Every multiplicity-m real heat contact has local index +floor(m/2) in (x,t), hence -floor(m/2) in (t,x), including degenerate contacts.
degree_composition.nontriviality: For 0<=mu<=1 all five theta coefficients are nonnegative and the first four are positive, so F_mu(t,0)>0 and the heat solution is nontrivial.
degree_composition.zero_degree_exclusion: Any contact would contribute a strictly negative integer to total degree. Since the degree is zero, the rectangle contains no contacts.

mu_zero_winding.convex_segment_homotopy: Each true mu=0 segment image and its endpoint chord lie in the same convex interval rectangle, which excludes the origin by one component.
mu_zero_winding.orientation: positive boundary orientation in coordinate order (t,x): x=x_low upward in t, t=t_high rightward in x, x=x_high downward in t, t=t_low leftward in x

proof_boundary: This excludes contacts only for the finite fifth-summand homotopy inside the declared local positive-time rectangle. It does not control other frequency rectangles, negative heat time, summands n>=6, the complete theta/Xi transform, an Xi collision, a degree-uniform Jensen remainder, Lambda<=0, RH, or a prize-level conclusion.
scaling_frontier: The full fifth coefficient is handled in one initial mu slab if maximum_depth=0. Use the stored H_5 derivative boxes to seek a summable all-n boundary perturbation bound before adding further terms individually.
status: rigorous fifth-summand positive-time exclusion certificate complete

tail_audit.combined_family: For 0<=mu<=1, the first-four-plus-mu*fifth tail is below 5*10^-1800, hence below the attached 10^-1500 radius.
tail_audit.moment_transfer: Multiplication by u^m*exp(t*u^2) is nonnegative for real t and u>=2; therefore every absolute n=5 tail moment through m=60 is bounded by the already certified n=4 tail moment.
tail_audit.n5_dominance: Write z=pi*n^2*exp(4u). Then phi_n(u)=exp(u)*z*(2z-3)*exp(-z). For z>3, the z derivative has sign -2z^2+7z-3=-(2z-1)(z-3)<0. On u>=2 and n>=4, z>3*16*2000>3, so 0<phi_5(u)<phi_4(u).

parent_n_le_4_audit.weighted_family_note: The n=1,2,3 plus lambda_c*n=4 sum has total tail below 4*10^-1800, hence below the attached 10^-1500 radius.

theorem: For every 0<=mu<=1, H_1+H_2+H_3+H_4+mu H_5 and its first x derivative have no common zero in [0,0.45]x[135.5,136].
